# GitHub Copilot Instructions

You are working on the RL Digital API Documentation Platform.

Always follow these rules:

1. Hugo is the static site generator.
2. Docsy is the selected theme.
3. OpenAPI is the source of truth.
4. Swagger UI must remain integrated.
5. Avoid custom JavaScript unless absolutely necessary.
6. Prefer Hugo features over external libraries.
7. Documentation must be maintainable by non-developers.
8. Generate reusable components.
9. Follow the folder structure exactly.
10. Use Markdown whenever possible.
11. All examples must be production-ready.
12. Keep internal and external documentation aligned.
